title: Adaptive Study System — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Adjusts practice questions to the student's performance in real time. The Adaptive Study System adjusts practice questions to student performance. It starts at a medium difficulty, makes questions harder when the student answers correctly and easier when they struggle, and tracks mastery per topic. The student always practices at the edge of their ability — never bored, never lost — and the system knows exactly which topics are mastered.
capabilities: Keep practice at the right challenge level
